caption:
Figure 3. Overall framework of our proposed ERR. Building on the insight from progressive spectral perspective, ERR consists of three
collaborative sub-networks: the zero-frequency enhancer (ZFE), the low-frequency restorer (LFR), and the high-frequency refiner (HFR).
delegated_acceptance_review: Reviewed final original ERR architecture and three enlarged original stage outputs with caption and pair evidence. ZFE/LFR/HFR blocks, all original branches, losses, DCT/IDCT and module legends remain intact. Tiny red loss-line endpoint pixels on the first two enlarged output borders are source crop artifacts, not new scientific connections; retained as visual limitations for honest quality scoring. Four protected regions independently replayed with exact nearest-neighbor enlargement.
